## Contribution checklist

<!-- Use CONTRIBUTING.md. Explain any unchecked or inapplicable item. -->
- [ ] Scope is focused; unrelated changes and sensitive data are excluded
- [ ] Changed behavior has regression and relevant failure/lifecycle tests
- [ ] Lint, typecheck, build, and full tests passed, or the prose-only exception/blockers are explained
- [ ] Ownership, validation, sandbox/approval, and compatibility impacts were reviewed
- [ ] Applicable web UI and CLI/TUI paths are complete
- [ ] Docs, config examples, and agent-facing prompt sources are current
- [ ] Applicable platform, packaging, performance, and manual checks are recorded
